Process Static GTAP Data with Simplified Parameter Structure

Source: R/GTAPauto.R
auto_gtap.Rd

Processes static GTAP data from .sl4 or .har files with a simplified parameter structure similar to auto_gtap_rd. Supports automatic processing of macro variables, bilateral trade data, and regular variables with flexible filtering and output options.

Usage

auto_gtap(
  experiment,
  input_path = NULL,
  input_format = ".sl4",
  input_suffix = "",
  process_vars = NULL,
  mapping_info = "GTAPv7",
  external_mapping_info = NULL,
  extract_method = "get_data_by_var",
  priority_list = NULL,
  convert_unit = NULL,
  decimals = 4,
  rename_columns = TRUE,
  region_select = NULL,
  sector_select = NULL,
  subtotal_level = FALSE,
  main_output_name = "plot.data",
  macro_output_name = "GTAPMacro",
  keep_raw_data = TRUE
)

Arguments

experiment

Character vector. Case names to process (without file extension). Example: c("EXP1", "EXP2", "EXP3").

input_path

Character. Path to the input folder containing GTAP data files.

input_format

Character. File format to process. Options:

  • ".sl4": Solution files (default)

  • ".har": Header array files

input_suffix

Character. Custom suffix for input files (e.g., "", "-custom", "-WEL"). Default: "".

process_vars

Character vector, data frame, NULL, or FALSE. Variables to extract:

  • Character vector: Specific variable names to extract

  • Data frame: Must contain a "Variable" column with variable names

  • NULL: Extract all available variables (default)

  • FALSE: Skip variable processing

Special keywords: "macro", "macros", "gtapmacro" trigger macro processing.

mapping_info

Character. Metadata mode for variable descriptions and units. Options:

  • "GTAPv7": Use default GTAPv7 definitions (default)

  • "Yes": Use external mapping only

  • "No": No mapping information

  • "Mix": Combine GTAPv7 defaults with external mapping (external takes precedence)

See add_mapping_info for details.

external_mapping_info

Data frame or NULL. Custom mapping table with columns: "Variable", "Description", "Unit". Overrides default mappings when mapping_info = "Yes" or "Mix". Default: NULL.

extract_method

Character. Method for extracting data from files:

  • "get_data_by_var": Extract by variable name (default)

  • "get_data_by_dims": Extract by dimension structure

  • "group_data_by_dims": Group and extract by dimension with priority rules

priority_list

Optional list. Priority rules required when extract_method = "group_data_by_dims". Specifies dimension hierarchy for grouping. Example: list("Sector" = c("COMM", "ACTS"), "Region" = c("REG")). Default: NULL.

convert_unit

Character or NULL. Unit conversion to apply:

  • "mil2bil": Convert millions to billions

  • "bil2mil": Convert billions to millions

  • "pct2frac": Convert percentage to fraction

  • "frac2pct": Convert fraction to percentage

Default: NULL (no conversion). See convert_units for details.

decimals

Integer or NULL. Number of decimal places for rounding numeric values. Set to NULL to disable rounding. Default: 4.

rename_columns

Logical. If TRUE, renames GTAP dimension codes to readable names:

  • "REG" → "Region"

  • "COMM" → "Commodity"

  • "ACTS" → "Activity"

  • "Experiment" → "Scenario"

Default: TRUE.

region_select

Character vector or NULL. Filter data to selected regions. Applies only to the "REG" (or "Region" if renamed) column. Default: NULL (all regions).

sector_select

Character vector or NULL. Filter data to selected sectors. Applies to "ACTS" and "COMM" (or "Activity" and "Commodity" if renamed) columns. Default: NULL (all sectors).

subtotal_level

Logical. If TRUE, includes subtotal rows in the output for aggregated dimensions. Default: FALSE.

main_output_name

Character. Variable name to assign main/primary data output in parent environment. Default: "plot.data".

macro_output_name

Character. Variable name to assign macro economic data output in parent environment. Default: "GTAPMacro".

keep_raw_data

Logical. Reserved parameter for future compatibility with comparison features. Currently not used. Default: TRUE.

Value

Invisibly returns a list containing processed data:

GTAPMacros

Macro economic indicators data frame (if processed)

main_data

Primary variable data frame or list (if processed)

bilateral_data

QXS bilateral trade data (if processed)

All processed data is also assigned to specified variable names in the parent environment.

Details

Automatic Processing:

The function automatically processes different data types based on file format and parameters:

  • Macro variables: Automatically processed from .sl4 files when process_vars = NULL or includes "macro", "macros", or "gtapmacro"

  • QXS (bilateral trade): Automatically processed from .sl4 files when process_vars = NULL or includes variables with "qxs" in the name

  • Regular variables: Processed based on extract_method and process_vars

File Discovery:

The function automatically discovers available input files and reports missing files. Files must match the pattern: experiment_name + input_suffix + input_format

Output Structure:

All outputs include standardized columns:

  • Variable: Variable identifier

  • Value: Numeric data values

  • Experiment or Scenario: Case identifier (depends on rename_columns)

  • Unit: Variable units (required for GTAPViz plotting functions)

  • Description: Variable description (if mapping is enabled)

  • Additional dimension columns (REG, COMM, ACTS, etc.)

Unit Conversion:

When convert_unit is specified, the conversion is applied to all processed data (main data, macro data, and bilateral trade data). The Unit column is automatically updated to reflect the conversion.

Differences from auto_gtap_data:

  • Processes single format per call (not simultaneous SL4 + HAR)

  • Simplified parameter structure matching auto_gtap_rd

  • Uses experiment vector instead of complex experiment lists

  • Automatic output assignment to parent environment

See also

auto_gtap_data for multi-format processing, auto_gtap_rd for recursive dynamic data processing, add_mapping_info for variable metadata, convert_units for unit conversions

Author

Pattawee Puangchit

Examples

# Input Path:
input_path <- system.file("extdata/in", package = "GTAPViz")

# Example 1: Process all variables from SL4 files (macros + regular + QXS)
# Files: EXP1.sl4, EXP2.sl4
gtap_data <- auto_gtap(
  experiment = c("EXP1", "EXP2"),
  input_path = input_path,
  input_format = ".sl4",
  process_vars = NULL,
  mapping_info = "GTAPv7",
  subtotal_level = FALSE,
  main_output_name = "plot.data"
)
#> Processing GTAP Macro Data
#> Processing SL4 Data
#> Processing QXS Bilateral Data
#> GTAP Macro Data processed successfully
#> SL4 Data processed successfully
#> QXS Bilateral Data processed successfully
#> GTAP static data processing completed successfully!
